description: This file contains PHPUnit test cases for the ScreenPermissionService class in the OrangeHRM project, focusing on authorization and permission retrieval functionalities.

classes.name: ScreenPermissionServiceTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the ScreenPermissionService in OrangeHRM, validating permission logic and screen retrieval.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by creating an instance of ScreenPermissionService.

methods.name: testGetScreenPermissionsNoneWithNoScreen
methods.description: Tests permission retrieval when no screen is defined; expects default permissive ResourcePermission.

methods.name: testGetScreenPermissionsNoneWithScreenDefined
methods.description: Tests permission retrieval when a screen is defined but no permissions exist; expects restrictive ResourcePermission.

methods.name: testGetScreenPermissionsOne
methods.description: Tests permission merging with one user role and multiple permissions, verifying combined access permissions.

methods.name: testGetScreenPermissionsTwo
methods.description: Tests permission retrieval with multiple roles, ensuring correct permission aggregation.

methods.name: testGetScreenPermissionsMany
methods.description: Tests permission retrieval with multiple roles and permissions, verifying correct permission conjunction.

methods.name: testGetScreen
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of a Screen entity by module and action parameters.

methods.name: verifyPermissions
methods.description: Helper method to assert the boolean states of permissions in a ResourcePermission instance.
